**Faithfulness:** Every concrete claim in the generated section — the "five years" minimum (Ali2013), denitrification-wall cost per unit nitrate (Jaynes2008), March–July high-flow window (Schilling2013), δ¹⁸O of nitrification-derived nitrate (Hu2024), boron isotopes around feedlots (Komor1997), Kanwar1999's sampler/logger details, the four "more research" quotations, etc. — traces to supporting content in the source.

**Citation provenance:** Every `\parencite`/`\textcite` key in the generated section appears in the source attached to the same content that supports the generated claim. Spot-checked all keys across all six subsections (Rogger2017, SHALIT1995/Malone2014/Woo2023/GUPTA1993, Clifford2023, BUHLER1993, Kladivko2001, Sharpley2019, Singh2022b, Frankenberger2024, Williams2022/Hu2024/Briand2017, Zhang2018, Ghirardini2019, Schilling2013, Pagliari2021, Andrus2014, etc.) — all match. The only borderline case, Frankl2023 grouped with Frison2009 for long-term soil evolution, is supported: Frankl2023 is cited in the source for "tracking soil physical, biological, and carbon properties over time," consistent with the generated framing.
